decision_rules_ordered: If FIVE topologies are feasible at 240 challenges/topology under Tier-C rates, retain all five and authorize B7 over five hypotheses.
Else if FOUR topologies after prospectively dropping 2v4 are feasible at 240/topology under the same rates, freeze four-topology scope and authorize B7 over four hypotheses.
Else STOP: do not run B7; current source still cannot support the required diverse high-information study.

diversity_contract.interpretation: Preserve B6B Tier C concentration RATES rather than accepting B6C broad relaxation.

purpose: Use a fresh candidate-blind current calculator FV source and a broader deterministic source-frame search before deciding whether five topologies can be retained or 2v4 must prospectively remain on V1.7.

solver_certainty_contract.FEASIBLE: finite incumbent independently satisfies every hard constraint; optimality not required
solver_certainty_contract.PROVEN_INFEASIBLE: HiGHS status 2 with no feasible incumbent
solver_certainty_contract.UNKNOWN_OTHER: all other unresolved states; operational failure, not scientific infeasibility
solver_certainty_contract.UNKNOWN_TIMEOUT: status 1 with no feasible incumbent; operational failure, not scientific infeasibility

source_rule.availability_universe: union of every current league-rostered player plus current free_agents entries with status Active
source_rule.fv_source_of_truth: current checked-out index.html through scripts/validation/snapshot_values.py at workflow runtime
source_rule.idp_inclusion_continuity: DL/LB/DB were already present in the frozen V7 source; this is not a topology/population expansion
source_rule.normalized_name_collision_policy: detect across source player_ids, live PLAYER_DB keys, and value_uncertainty keys; exclude ambiguous normalized names before FV matching
source_rule.rostered_status_policy: retain rostered assets across transient injury/status flags, but exclude explicit Retired status
source_rule.value_uncertainty_role: identity/position and stale-center diagnostic cross-check only; center_value is not an FV authority because the artifact is generated asynchronously and RB values continuously age with date

targets_120_and_180_role: diagnostic capacity only; they cannot override a failed 240 authorization gate
v2_operational_failure_repair: V2 stopped before candidate generation because asynchronous value_uncertainty center_value was incorrectly required to exactly equal current runtime live FV; V3 changes source-integrity plumbing only, not candidate/science/decision rules.
